comment: Illustrative NCCI Procedure-to-Procedure (PTP) edits and an ICD-10 to CPT medical-necessity crosswalk. Real NCCI/LCD/NCD edits are published quarterly by CMS; this is a small demonstration set.

ncci_ptp.rationale: 93005 (tracing only) is a component of 93000 (complete ECG); not separately reportable.
93010 (interpretation only) is a component of 93000 (complete ECG); not separately reportable.
Open and laparoscopic appendectomy on same session - bundled; modifier allowed only if separate anatomic site/session.
No edit (indicator 9 = not applicable); panels are separately reportable.
